master:
Use case: sketch-to-render. IMAGE1 fixes the complete geometry and framing. IMAGE2 is STYLE ONLY. Render Level04 as a premium hand-painted 2D side-view forest platformer environment, 2048x768, wide 8:3. Trace all GREEN terrain silhouettes and BEIGE HORIZONTAL FIXED platforms exactly from image1, including their widths, spacing, stepped edges and overhangs. Keep the added upper sky band, don't crop or move terrain upward. Fill all negative spaces with distant scenery, never new gameplay structures. ALL gaps reach the bottom edge, no bottom connecting floor or border.
The four disconnected terrain groups: left start with ascending two steps to a narrow pier and overhanging cap; center low island with a narrow support under its wide cap; taller third island with high pier, wide cap, and low step extending to its right; final high exit massif at right with a long shelf projecting to its left, an undercut lower-left edge, and small lower step at extreme right. Keep this irregular right outline exactly. Four broad beige horizontal platforms are fixed; keep all four. The central vertical beige rod hovering over the first gap is an INTERACTIVE reflector mechanism: omit it entirely, along with its small pad on left shelf. NO replacement object or column in that gap. Yellow exit marker becomes a small empty mossy stone arch near the LEFT edge of the high right bank, not at far right; preserve its intended location. No door or seal.
Distinct art: ochre sandstone ancient ruins and earth-colored carved masonry wrapped in moss, huge interlaced roots, very large ruined circular arches far in the background, dense warm green forest shade with shafts of soft sunlight. Use IMAGE2's painted richness, crisp thin grassy top lines, tasteful ferns and vines attached to stone, turquoise distant depth and warm gold highlights. Strong 2D side elevation, no 3D/isometric/pixel style. Foreground canopy in upper corners only. No painted waterfalls or water, moving mist, particles or large hanging vines; separate effects later. No UI/text/labels/grid/borders/arrows, no characters, hazards, blocks, gems, mechanisms, plates, rods, elevator or moving platform. Do not redesign any geometry.
static:
Use case: background-extraction. Extract the exact near gameplay environment from this master image onto REAL transparent alpha. Preserve canvas 2048x768, framing, all object positions and sizes exactly. Keep ALL sunlit grassy platforms, ground, stone columns, cliffs, timber braces, right empty stone arch, moss/ferns attached to them, and ONLY the near corner framing tree branches/leaves. Remove ALL distant blue/teal forest, sky, distant ruins/aqueduct, distant mountains and haze, leaving genuine alpha in every gap, pit, below floating bridges, and inside the empty exit arch. Do not redesign or shift anything, do not add structure, do not fill pits. Keep the sunlit thin platform tops exactly. No water, text, characters, grid, effects. Transparent PNG cutout at the same very wide 8:3 ratio, no contact sheet, no shadow backdrop.
Maintain the FOUR disconnected terrain groups, all four horizontal caps, all THREE full-depth empty gaps and the undercut bottom-left edge of the right massif. Remove distant roots/trees/ruins entirely. No bottom connecting border.
background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a clean BACKGROUND PLATE from this exact master composition. Keep the same 2048x768 wide canvas and distant forest/canopy, sky, mountains, turquoise atmosphere and distant sandstone arches placement and brushwork. Erase ALL sharp sunlit foreground gameplay masonry, every ground bank/platform/column/bridge/exit arch and foreground ferns; reconstruct the distant forest seamlessly behind their former positions. Also remove near corner framing branches/tree trunk. The resulting image has only distant non-walkable soft painted forest and ancient atmospheric ruins. No horizontal foreground walkable ground, no readable platforms anywhere. DRY scenery: no waterfall or water streams, no mist sprite effects, no floating particles, no hanging foreground vines. No UI, grid, text, characters or mechanisms. This is inpainting the same scene, not a new composition.
